packageRules.description: Disable Renovate's github-actions manager for python in tests.yml; the python/bash jobs' 3.9 pin is frozen. See CLAUDE.md's 'Python 3.9 pin' section.

customManagers.description: Keep the devcontainer's tooling-Python pin (`tooling_python` in post-create.sh) current. Only the annotated assignment is matched, so the frozen 3.9.6 in the same file is never touched.
Keep the molecule CI job's Python pin (`python-version` under setup-python) current — should track the devcontainer's `tooling_python` (post-create.sh) so local dev and CI agree on the interpreter.
